faq.a: Our flagship technical event in December: two days of workshops, coding competitions and 20+ interactive booths, all run on its own currency: Epoch Coins.
Everyone starts with 398 Epoch Coins, credited at check-in. Spend them at booths and on merch, and top up at recharge points. The ticket price (if any) hasn't been decided yet.
Yes. Recharge points run mini-games (trivia, quick coding puzzles) worth around 20 coins. Each recharge point works once per person.

faq.q: Do I need to know how to code?
faq.a: No. The year starts with a beginner session, Learn GitHub & Make Your First Contribution, and every event is built to be approachable.

faq.q: How do I join, and where are events announced?
faq.a: Fill in the Join form on this page and hop into our WhatsApp community. That's where we share dates, workshops and RSVP links. Follow us on Instagram and LinkedIn too.

faq.q: How do I join the core team?
faq.a: We open applications when the team is growing, usually at the start of a term, and announce them on WhatsApp and Instagram. While a round is open, apply at /apply: it takes about ten minutes, and the reviewers reply to everyone by email.
The GitHub Community Club at GITAM University Bengaluru: students organising for students.
